data.title: Bußgeldbescheid wegen überfälliger Hauptuntersuchung (§ 24 Abs. 1 StVG)
data.summary: The Bußgeldstelle (fine office) of the city of Musterwilhelmshaven issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) against the person for driving a vehicle whose Hauptuntersuchung (periodic vehicle inspection) was more than four months overdue on 1 October 2026. The total amount due is €92.00 (fine €60.00, fee €28.50, delivery costs €3.50), and the notice was delivered by Postzustellungsurkunde on 23 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice for driving with an overdue vehicle inspection. One point is also recorded in the driving register (Fahreignungsregister). You may decide to object (Einspruch) to this notice in writing or in person at the Bußgeldstelle; the app shows the deadline for that. If you do nothing and the notice becomes final, the €92.00 becomes due two weeks after that happens, though the exact payment date isn't automatically computed here since it depends on when the notice legally becomes final. If you disagree, consider getting advice from a lawyer (Rechtsanwalt) specializing in traffic law before the objection window closes.

remedy.quote: Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung bei der Stadt Musterwilhelmshaven – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.

key_facts.label: Points in driving register (Fahreignungsregister)
key_facts.quote: Im Fahreignungsregister wird der Verstoß mit 1 Punkt vermerkt.

items.title: Decide whether to object to the fine (Einspruch)
items.action: Decide whether to file a written objection (Einspruch) against the fine notice with the Bußgeldstelle, by letter or in person, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you do not object in time, the fine notice becomes final (rechtskräftig) and the €92.00 becomes payable.
items.quote: Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung bei der Stadt Musterwilhelmshaven – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.

items.title: Pay the fine amount if the notice becomes final
items.action: Pay the total amount of €92.00 to the Bußgeldstelle's account once the notice becomes legally final, unless you have objected.
items.consequence: If the amount is not paid once due, enforcement measures may follow.

date.text: Fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist.
